## Environment

- Node version (if running from source): `node --version`
- LLM provider(s) involved: (Ollama / OpenAI / StepFun / …)
- Model(s) involved: (gpt-4o-mini / deepseek-chat / local-llama-3.2-3b / …)

## Screenshots

If applicable, add screenshots to help explain the problem.

## Additional context

Add any other context about the problem here. Stack traces from the
